description: Probability that the price touches a barrier (a target or a stop level) at ANY time within N days, under geometric Brownian motion (reflection principle with drift). This is not the probability of finishing beyond the level at expiry: at zero log-drift a touch is exactly twice as likely as a finish, and `finishBeyondProbabilityPct` is returned next to it for comparison (the end-of-window question itself is `workflow.run_window_fair_value`). Barrier above spot gives an up-touch, below spot a down-touch. Monitoring is continuous (every instant, not daily closes or candle highs, which touch less often); year is 365 days; `driftPct` is the annualized expected price drift, default 0. Output: touchProbabilityPct, finishBeyondProbabilityPct, direction, barrierDistancePct.

barrier.description: The level to touch, same units as spot. Above spot: up-touch; below spot: down-touch

daysToExpiry.description: Calendar days in the window (can be fractional, up to 3650)

driftPct.description: Annualized expected price drift in percentage points. Default 0.

volatilityPct.description: Annualized volatility in percentage points (e.g. 60 for 60%), at least 0.01
